description: Animal, tree and left-edge figure appear unchanged across tiles at 480x270; sub-pixel figure motion cannot be excluded (peak diff 1.29 MEASURED).
Scene slides leftward across all 8 tiles: big tree moves from right edge toward centre and animal moves off left; displacement continues f4320-f4327; easing not measurable.
Bearded figure present at left edge in f4320, absent from f4321.
Grey rock enters at lower right at f4320 and grows into view by f4322 with the pan.
Timeline row scrolls leftward, label '5' x-position 207,199,187,171,158,150,143,140 (tile px) so per-frame speed decreases; further silhouette enters at right.
Eagle grows gradually and drifts slightly up-left across tiles; no text yet.
Map drifts up-left (Australia label y from ~100 to ~60 tile-px) as NZ moves toward centre; combined with apparent enlargement.
Australia and its label look larger in later tiles (clipped at left by f4573).
Narrator head drifts left about 40 tile-px across the 8 tiles; chalk text unchanged.
Eagle sweeps right and down toward the warrior's spear tip (f4860 touches tip region), wings alternately raised and lowered; warrior's spear also repositions.
Eagle rises to top-right and leaves frame by f4876-f4877; warrior and landscape static.
Eagle and '33 lbs (15 kg)' label slide upward and are cropped out at top (label cut at f5013, gone f5014); camera pan vs object tween not distinguishable.
Label and eagle leave top edge.
Front-facing eagle rises upward by ~60 tile-px, decelerating, then holds from f5024.
Thin black measure line appears at f5025 and lengthens over f5026-f5027.
Pointer stick and narrator shift slightly; painting essentially unchanged; peak diff 1.22 MEASURED is low.
'440 lbs (200 kg)' label enters from top (partly cropped f5288), moves down and settles about f5292-f5293.
Moa-like bird walks, legs alternate; head bobs.
Cloud layer passes in front of eagle causing washed-out look; cleared from f5603; layer mechanics UNAVAILABLE.
Perched eagle enlarges and drifts up-left across tiles; small head-angle change.
Pointer swings up from lower left to the bird's pelvis; narrator mouth moves.
Blackboard, poster text ('TION' to 'UTION') and figure enlarge/shift across tiles.
Eagle lands on the bird's back (f5862-f5863); bird sags and tips over, legs flung back by f5866-f5868.
Background pine/rocks shift slightly leftward in later tiles; small, not measured.
